pages.title: Utopia & Village
pages.text: $(6)Utopia$() is the reward dimension: gentle skies, magic apple trees, and the $(l:orespawn_integrations:bosses/the_king)King Altar$() for whenever peace gets boring.$(p)$(6)The Village Dimension$() (Rainbow Ant) is settled country — streets of villagers who have never met a creeper and would very much like to keep it that way.

pages.title: Islands & Chaos
pages.text: $(6)The Islands$() (Unstable Ant) drift over open sky. Pack spare blocks, watch your step, and raid the monster isles for their vaults.$(p)$(4)Chaos$() (Butterfly) closes the list for a reason: Pitch Blacks, Lurking Terrors and worse own that sky. Arrive armed like you mean it. Leave before it gets personal.
